descriptionHtml:
Fantech ATO MP905 Super Maxfit Deskmat Gaming Mouse Pad

Transform your workspace into a premium, high-performance battle station layout with the Fantech ATO MP905 Super Maxfit Deskmat Gaming Mouse Pad. Available at Turbo Computer, this premium extra-large desk accessory is masterfully engineered for pro esports competitors, software developers, and custom PC builders across Egypt who demand continuous mouse tracking real estate, ultimate sensor responsiveness, and stable daily hardware performance.

The Fantech ATO MP905 features a massive Super Maxfit layout environment spanning 900mm by 400mm, perfectly protecting your entire desktop surface while accommodating both full-sized mechanical keyboards and high-end gaming mice. Outfitted with a premium moisture-resistant fabric surface optimized for both speed and control glide tracking, it utilizes seamless anti-fray stitched edge specs to prevent long-term wear. Secured by an ultra-stable, non-slip textured rubber base structure, it prevents unwanted shifting during intense tracking layouts.
